The Help card leads to Discord, and with TowerTorch every row and tab lights in its hover colour.

## ✨ Added
- The Help card offers the TollRoll Discord server beside GitHub.

## 🎨 Design
- GlimStone 4.5.4. With TowerTorch, the rows, chips, views, options and tabs of the tile and the settings page light in TowerTorch's hover colour, a soft tint of your accent, the same as TowerTorch's own rows and buttons.

## 🌐 Translations
- The Help sentence names GitHub and Discord in all 26 languages, and French readers are addressed with tu.
